name: What is the construction process for adding a pantry to an existing kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What is the construction process for adding a pantry to an existing kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a pantry involves design planning, rough construction, and finish carpentry. During planning, a general contractor assesses your floor plan, measures clearances, and determines whether walls are load-bearing. Demolition and framing follow, along with any necessary electrical rough-ins for interior outlets and lighting. Once drywall is hung, taped, and painted, carpenters install shelving, custom cabinetry, trim, and doors. A professional contractor manages trade sequencing and material delivery to coordinate the new pantry with your broader kitchen layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process covers layout planning, framing, rough electrical work, drywall installation, custom shelving or cabinetry, and final trim and painting.
